title: Plugin: Custom dock calls `_enter_tree` 3 times on launch.
body:
### Tested versions

4.6.rc2

### System information

Linux (Debian)

### Issue description

Custom docks have `_enter_tree` called three times upon launching a project in the editor. 

```
Godot Engine v4.6.rc2.official (c) 2007-present Juan Linietsky, Ariel Manzur & Godot Contributors.
--- Debug adapter server started on port 6006 ---
plugin entered tree
dock entered tree
--- GDScript language server started on port 6005 ---
dock entered tree
dock entered tree

```

This is an issue when the `plugin.gd` script, during `_enter_tree` performs special set up on the dock's scene before adding it to the dock's scene tree.

### Workaround?

The dock scene needs to work completely independently and set itself up. that said, having `_enter_tree` called 3 times seems inefficient.


### Steps to reproduce

Basically follow the [Making plugins]() docs, deviating just to add a quick print statement.

Then enable your plugin, and relaunch.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

```gdscript
@tool
extends EditorPlugin

var dock

func _enter_tree() -> void:
	print("plugin entered tree")
	var dock_scene = preload("res://addons/my_custom_dock/my_dock.tscn").instantiate()

	dock = EditorDock.new()
	dock.add_child(dock_scene)

	dock.title = "My Dock"
	dock.default_slot = DOCK_SLOT_LEFT_UL
	dock.available_layouts = EditorDock.DOCK_LAYOUT_VERTICAL | EditorDock.DOCK_LAYOUT_FLOATING

	add_dock(dock)


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	remove_dock(dock)
	dock.queue_free()
```

```gdscript
@tool
extends Button

func _enter_tree() -> void:
	print("dock entered tree")
```
